verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a first-party Batch API for processing groups of requests asynchronously when immediate results aren't needed (cerebras-docs-8), which covers the core async-batch submission. Nothing in the pack documents a discount for batch versus real-time pricing; the service-tier docs concern priority, not price. Missing for 10: documented batch pricing discount versus real-time rates, details of the job submission/retrieval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch usage.
